decisive_items: Step-up in oxygenation from superior vena cava (71%) and inferior vena cava (77%) to right atrium (84%)
response.rationale: The presence of a large defect with left-to-right shunt and step-up in oxygenation is more specific to atrial septal defect than the ECG findings of right bundle-branch block

rejected.why: Right bundle-branch block is a conduction abnormality, but it does not explain the large defect and step-up in oxygenation
